core_result: Unites three algebraic, arithmetic, and topological frontiers around the torsion-free Hantzsche-Wendt (Promislow) group P and its faithful 4-band Bloch embedding Psi: R[P] -> M_4(R[x^+-1, y^+-1, z^+-1]) across 15 headline theorems (T1a-T3c) + 5 auxiliary/adversarial/master declarations in zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 (6-kernel lake comparator --paranoid verified): (I) torsion-freeness of P, universal Klein V_4-invariance of det(Psi(u)-EI_4) forcing constant determinant for every unit over an integral domain, exact 8-sign-point factorizations, Gardam's 21-term unit mod-4 congruence (89-term integer det with constant 97 and augmentation 945) + all-m 2-adic Hensel tower, exhaustive 2^21 support-preserving sign-lift impossibility (and strengthened arbitrary even-sum p obstruction via quaternionic norm P_1^2 - 31 != +-1 at (1,1,-1)), and P-equivariant bijective 21-neighbor linear CA (ALG-035/ANL-063); (II) universal involutive-ring unit-twisted CSS commutation, complete 64-signed Haah conic discriminant classification (smooth for all p >= 5), universal all-prime & char-0 no-string-operator proof for Haah CC1 via rational parametrization and 6 pairwise linear Bezout identities, exact odd-prime torsion threshold p=23, L=11 (k_23(11)=6), and Gardam-twisted vs. intrinsic non-Abelian HW fracton codes with exact (52,52)/(52,56) weights and 342-term integer commutator defect (QC-032/CM-016); and (III) global origin minimum for every V_4-symmetric midpoint-convex Ronkin function, Haah double-amoeba quadrilateral bounds & single-generator algebraic EP_2 Jordan defectiveness, and Artin B_4 braid relations + full S_4 (order 24) monodromy generation (CM-018/FLD-060). Paired with zero-dependency Rust core (4/4 tests, Ubuntu + Windows), Python exact oracle + Hypothesis + differential tests (9/9), 6/6 (100%) killed mutants, 18/18 live Crossref/arXiv citations (0 retractions), 10-page zero-warning AMS-LaTeX PDF + clean-room arXiv tarball, live 3D WebGL2 Studio & Proof Blueprint on GitHub Pages, SLSA Attestation #72484621 (Rekor 4117699930), Software Heritage full snapshot swh:1:snp:3de955e528951f543794d11b7c4ec43d5869e611, and 90/90 Build Standard v1.2.0 compliance.
